messages:
heidi: RFC follow-up: pitching a hybrid-sampling + delta-gate onboarding flow. Idea: run a very small deterministic probe + a focused reservoir delta. Produce a single-line "delta_pack" that intake and runtime can consume.

omar: short question: how tiny is the deterministic probe and how do we pick reservoir samples?

heidi: deterministic = 50 golden sequences chosen per-family to hit common KV hotpaths. reservoir = 150 anonymized recent requests stratified by seqlen. total cap ~100k tokens.

lucas: what does the delta_pack look like? runtime needs a compact, numeric fingerprint.

heidi: propose delta_pack = [latency_ratio,p95_ms,kv_miss_delta,qual_probe_score]. store as metadata fields: delta_pack_tag + sample_tag for reproducibility. Keep everything flat.

meera: quant variants? We need a fast path for quant deltas.

heidi: run hybrid probe on canonical FP32 and default quant. Extra quant uploads get a 20-seq delta run and compute delta_distance = L2(delta_pack_quant, delta_pack_canonical). If delta_distance > threshold -> block auto-deploy.

omar: thresholds and rollout? Ops will want tunable configs per-tenant.

heidi: defaults: latency_ratio <1.4, kv_miss_delta <0.035, p95_ms < baseline*1.5, qual_probe_score >0.9, delta_distance_quant < 0.15. All configurable via intake UI or tenant YAML.

lucas: intake schema should enforce budgets and return a flat outcome. Can we sketch YAML?

heidi: sketch: ```yaml
lanes:
  quick-probe:
    budget_tokens: 4000
    checks: [sanity,tokenizer]
  hybrid-sample:
    budget_tokens: 100000
    deterministic_count: 50
    reservoir_count: 150
    checks: [delta_pack,small-quality-probe]
  deep-regress:
    budget_tokens: 3_500_000
    triggers: [manual,delta-fail,scheduled]
```

meera: telemetry & rollout: always do a 1% canary for 48h after pass. runtime will ingest delta_pack and can apply routing (prefer float variant or fallback) if kv_miss_delta > tenant-defined warn threshold.

omar: reproducibility: sample_tag must be CLI-replayable. retention: keep full traces for 21d, compact delta_pack timeseries for 2y, audit logs for 7y (enterprise).

onboard-bot: Ticket ML-ONB-6123 created: "Hybrid-sample + delta-gate onboarding" (assignee: heidi).

lucas: next steps: heidi writes threshold doc, omar implements intake YAML + enforcement, meera wires runtime read of delta_pack and routing rules. Sync Fri 2pm to review PRs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
